EXTRAORDINARY
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Notice under Section 7

Reference No.: GM/GAM/2023/31. Land Ministry's Ref. No. : 4-3/7/2020/HW/122. I hereby give notice under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, that the Government intends to acquire the following lands which are required for a public purpose. Description of the lands to be acquired: Lot Nos. 1-12 (12 Lots) allotments in total extent of about 0.2521 Hectare, of land in Cadastral Map No. 511860, Block No. 6 Sheet No. 3 and dated 09.04.2023 prepared by the Senior - Superintendent of Surveyor of Gampaha District on behalf of the Surveyor General, situated in the Village of Medagama, Grama Niladahari Division of No. 223A, Medagama 02, in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Gampaha in Gampaha District in the Western Province. 01. Lot No. 1 Name of land: Hikgahakumbura; Description: Paddy field; Claimant: State; Original Claimant: Hewawedhige Sarath Wimalasiri and Hewawedhige Tamara Dayani, No. 55/4, Hansagiri Road, Gampaha, (To finalise the land acquisition); Extent: 0.0113 Hectare.
